def solve(case):
    nodes = case['nodes']
    required_symbols = case['required_symbols']
    nodes_by_id = {n['id']: n for n in nodes}
    children = {}
    for n in nodes:
        pid = n['parent']
        if pid is not None:
            children.setdefault(pid, []).append(n['id'])
    retained = set(n['id'] for n in nodes)
    symbol_counts = {}
    for n in nodes:
        sym = n['symbol']
        symbol_counts[sym] = symbol_counts.get(sym, 0) + 1
    # order: deeper first, then id
    ordered = sorted(nodes, key=lambda n: (-n['depth'], n['id']))
    removed = []
    for n in ordered:
        nid = n['id']
        if not n['removable'] or n['depth'] == 0 or n['symbol'] in required_symbols:
            continue
        # check children not retained
        children_ids = children.get(nid, [])
        if any(cid in retained for cid in children_ids):
            continue
        # tentatively remove
        sym = n['symbol']
        symbol_counts[sym] -= 1
        # check required symbols
        if all(symbol_counts.get(rs, 0) > 0 for rs in required_symbols):
            # removal is valid
            retained.remove(nid)
            removed.append(nid)
        else:
            # revert
            symbol_counts[sym] += 1
    retained_ids = sorted(retained)
    return {"removed_node_ids": removed, "retained_node_ids": retained_ids}
